summary.note: Informational projection of the contract and receipt; only the statement and manifest are cryptographically bound.
summary.objective: Let an agent start from a contract a team approved in ForgeLoop Cloud for a ticket from any tracker: forgeloop contract-create --task <id> --from-ticket <source:externalId> fetches the approved contract with a team token, validates it exactly like a contract file and persists it, so the task reaches CONTRACT_READY without writing the contract by hand.
successCriteria: contract-create --from-ticket persists an approved Cloud contract and refuses proposals, missing tokens and invalid contracts

checks.requirement: contract-create --from-ticket persists an approved Cloud contract and refuses proposals, missing tokens and invalid contracts
